package.name: g1_base_bridge
package.description: Bridge between the cmd_vel Nav2 produces and the G1's active locomotion backend: Track A (Gazebo's VelocityControl plugin, idle legs) or Track B (unitree_rl_lab's RL walking policy, driven via the rt/lowstate wireless_remote relay-with-override pattern — see docs/plan.md, "M1 findings"). Track B requires unitree_sdk2_python (pip install, not a rosdep key) in addition to the ROS 2 deps below, since this package is a hybrid rclpy + raw-DDS process.
